subject: Copper Sword
text: The treasure chest in Midenhall, to the left after following the king down the stairs, contains a Copper Sword.

evidence.quote: you should look left to the treasure chest and open it. ... Inside, you'll find a COPPER SWORD and 50 GOLD.

subject: Midenhall treasure chest
text: The Midenhall treasure chest contains 50 gold.

evidence.quote: Inside, you'll find a COPPER SWORD and 50 GOLD.

subject: Hero inventory
text: The hero can carry only eight items at once, counting his weapon and armor.

evidence.quote: Your hero can only carry eight items at once, including his weapon and armor

subject: Medical Herb
text: Medical herbs can be bought in Midenhall for a long trip.

evidence.quote: unless you want to buy some medical herbs for a long trip.

subject: Antidote Herb
text: Antidote herbs are only useful later, so the guide advises not buying them yet at Midenhall.

evidence.quote: Later, you'll find the antidote herbs handy, but you shouldn't invest in those just yet.

subject: Midenhall inn
text: The Midenhall inn costs 4 gold per night at this point.

evidence.quote: It only costs you 4 gold per night at this point

subject: Midenhall
text: The guide suggests raising your level to 3 or 4 by fighting monsters just outside Midenhall.

evidence.quote: fight monsters long enough to raise it. ... I suggest increasing your level to 3 or 4

subject: Midenhall grinding
text: Once the hero reaches level 4, some enemies flee from battle, so staying in Midenhall is no longer useful.

evidence.quote: Once you're at level 4, there's really no point in staying here any longer. ... Some of the enemies will run from battle, just because your level is so high.
